mentions.name: Verva
mentions.description: This is a reader app designed for language learning that lets users read and listen to content in their target language (currently English, Spanish, French, German, and Italian), with smart features for teaching and testing progress. It offers a library of Aesop's Fables that is being expanded, and is preparing for official launch with an open beta on iOS.
mentions.audience: Language learners studying English, Spanish, French, German, or Italian
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building a reader app designed for language learning. It's a place where you can read and listen to plenty of content in your target language (currently English, Spanish, French, German and Italian) and also comes with plenty of smart bits for helping to teach you and test your progress.
